decisions.reason: Changing the date display format does not affect whether interactive fields maintain independent content.

The source decision concerns date formatting, not retention of the Title field's visual formatting.
The date display format does not alter editable-field visual cues or empty-field visibility.
Although date fields appear in this Requirement's history, selecting day/month/year display does not change placeholder-clearing behavior.
The date-picker display choice does not change the representation or architecture of ordinary text-entry fields.
The acceptance at message 273 resolves the preceding date-picker proposal; headline Enter support is addressed separately after this message.
Date display formatting does not affect hard-return spacing in continuous text.
The source decision does not change automatic word wrapping or column containment.
The accepted date display format does not change field-cell padding or right-side text spacing.
The date-picker format decision does not enable, disable, or otherwise modify the Board Meeting dropdown control.
The date-picker format decision does not alter the Indstilling checklist control or its enabled state.
